items.title: 10.5 Oxidation number ke tareeqe se redox muadle balance karna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.5 with Sample 10.4 and the Keep in Mind box, printed pages 217-219.

items: Redox reaction ka khaka (skeleton) muadla likhein.
Woh elements pehchanein jin ka oxidation number reaction ke doran badalta hai.
Un elements ke symbols ke oopar oxidation numbers likhein.
Dono taraf ke atoms ko jorte teeron se oxidation number ki tabdeeli dikhayein; yeh hasil ya khoye gaye electrons dikhata hai.
Oxidation number ke izafe aur kami (khoye aur hasil electrons) ko munasib hindson se zarb de kar barabar karein.
Baqi muadla inspection (hit and trial) se balance karein.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain aur yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Inspection ki tarteeb: pehle N, O aur H ke siwa sab elements balance karein; phir nitrogen; phir oxygen; aakhir mein hydrogen. Agar kisi element ka oxidation number sirf barhe ya sirf ghate to us ki species daen taraf ek baar likhi jati hai (Zn + HCl se ZnCl2 + H2). Agar woh barhe bhi aur ghate bhi (disproportionation) to species daen taraf do baar likhi jati hai, pehle izafe ke liye phir kami ke liye (Cl2 + NaOH se NaCl + H2O + NaOCl). Agar woh badle aur be-tabdeel bhi rahe to bhi do baar likhi jati hai, pehle tabdeeli ke liye phir be-tabdeeli ke liye (HNO3 + Cu se Cu(NO3)2 + H2O + NO2; HCl + K2Cr2O7 se Cl2 + KCl + CrCl3 + H2O).
Sample Problem 10.4: dichromate aur hydrochloric acid

Khaka: K2Cr2O7 + HCl se Cl2 + KCl + CrCl3 + H2O. Oxidation numbers: baen K +1, Cr +6, O -2, H +1, Cl -1; Cl2 mein Cl 0, CrCl3 mein Cr +3. Chromium +6 se +3 badalta aur reduce hota hai (K2Cr2O7 oxidising agent); chlorine -1 se 0 badalta aur oxidise hota hai (HCl reducing agent). Half-reactions: K2Cr2O7 se 2CrCl3 (reduction) aur 2HCl se Cl2 (oxidation). Cr ki kami K2Cr2O7 ke fi molecule 6 units; Cl ka izafa HCl ke 2 molecules par 2 units, to 6 electrons barabar karne ke liye oxidation half ko 3 se zarb dete hain: 6HCl se 3Cl2. Muadla K2Cr2O7 + 6HCl se 3Cl2 + KCl + 2CrCl3 + H2O ban jata hai. Inspection se 2KCl chahiye; Cl aur K balance karne ke liye HCl ke 14 molecules chahiye, to baen 8 HCl shamil kiye jate hain; hydrogen aur oxygen ke liye daen 7H2O. Balanced: K2Cr2O7 + 14HCl se 2KCl + 2CrCl3 + 3Cl2 + 7H2O.

blocks.caption: Sample 10.4 mein electrons ka hisab
rows: 3, jo 3Cl2 aur 6 HCl oxidised deta hai

blocks.prompt: MnO2 + HCl se MnCl2 + H2O + Cl2 ko oxidation number ke tareeqe se balance karein (Quick Check 10.3ii).
blocks.explanation: Mn +4 se +2 girta hai (2 electrons hasil); Cl -1 se 0 barhta hai, fi Cl2 2 electrons, to fi MnO2 ek Cl2. MnO2 + 2HCl(oxidised) se MnCl2 + Cl2 + H2O; do aur HCl MnCl2 ka chloride dete hain aur do oxygens ko 2H2O chahiye: MnO2 + 4HCl se MnCl2 + Cl2 + 2H2O.

items: Oxidation number ka tareeqa: khaka; badalne wale elements dhundein; tabdeeliyan nishan-zada karein; khoye aur hasil electrons zarb se barabar karein; inspection se mukammal karein (baqi, phir N, O, H).
Sample 10.4: Cr +6 se +3 (6 e-), Cl -1 se 0 (fi Cl2 2 e-) se 3Cl2; K2Cr2O7 + 14HCl se 2KCl + 2CrCl3 + 3Cl2 + 7H2O.
